schema.dataGranularityDescription: One witness key this release no longer publishes, with its successor, its candidates, or neither

properties.name: old_key

customProperties.value: Disjoint from witnesses.witness_key. Carried witness keys stay in witnesses.parquet across re-fetches and parser splits; only edited names (locator), ambiguous multiplicity changes, carried 1-hop ledger entries, and reviewed historical Senate keys enter witness_key_map (ct-46f3). Any unmapped live key refuses export (lost_witness_keys). A name alone never maps (ct-30fp).

properties.description: A witness_key that an earlier body or capture context held for an occasion produces and this release does not publish in witnesses

properties.name: witness_key

customProperties.value: The successor can itself be superseded_by a higher-ranked row of the same person; follow witnesses.superseded_by to the row to show.

properties.description: The current witnesses.witness_key the old key resolves to; null when status is ambiguous or unresolved

properties.name: status
properties.description: unambiguous (one successor), ambiguous (several candidates, listed in candidate_keys, none chosen) or unresolved (no candidate)

properties.name: basis
properties.description: The strongest evidence found: occurrence (the same body and locator, published under another occasion or capture context), content (the same occasion, source and print, with an equal name and equal other attributes, at least one of them stated or the same locator; repeats of one person pair in list order) or locator (the same locator, occasion, source and print, an edited name of the same family and given name, every other attribute equal and a position, organization or Bioguide ID stated); null when unresolved

properties.name: candidate_keys

items.description: Possible current witness key for an ambiguous earlier key.

properties.description: With status ambiguous: the current witness keys the old key could resolve to, sorted; empty otherwise

properties.name: occasion
properties.description: The occasion the old key's body is filed under in this release (meeting:{event_id}, package:{package_id}, or page:{sha256_prefix})

properties.name: source
properties.description: Observation source family of the old key (house_xml, congress_gov, senate_page, or mods)

customProperties.value: witness_key is set exactly when status is unambiguous; basis is null exactly when status is unresolved (ct-kb4w).

value: Five historical Senate page keys from pre-ledger releases whose pages no longer belong to any meeting carry reviewed status unresolved in model/registries/historical-witness-keys.json
